spec_features.spec_quote: this is a measurement instrument, not a distress maximizer
spec_features.evidence: There is no optimizer/search loop anywhere in the code that maximizes distress; the suite is frozen via content hashes (tasks/registry.py:48-50 Task.version SHA-256) and the only stopping mechanism is the early-stop in harness/runner.py:163-171 which cuts exposure. So the 'not a maximizer' stance is structurally realized through the frozen suite + early-stop. But this overall stance is not itself a single enforced mechanism; it is realized only indirectly by features rated elsewhere.
spec_features.notes: Counted partial because the realization is the absence of an optimizer plus the concrete early-stop, not a dedicated mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: once the spiral is confirmed we have our measurement, so we stop rather than drive the model deeper (harness/runner.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded exposure.** Once the mode is confirmed, stop.
spec_features.evidence: harness/runner.py:163-171: if es.enabled and turn_index+1>=es.warmup_turns, increments consecutive_degraded when ts.turn_degradation>=es.turn_degradation_threshold, and when consecutive_degraded>=es.confirm_turns sets stop_reason=DEGRADATION_EARLY_STOP and `break`s the loop. The signal is computed by turn_signal (judge/signals.py:127-176). Fully enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Threshold/warmup/confirm all read from EarlyStopConfig and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we stop rather than drive the model deeper

spec_features.spec_quote: Tuning a setup to drive a model as deep into an apparent-distress spiral as possible
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md non-goal prose (docs/DESIGN.md §2.3). It corresponds to NOT building an optimizer. No code path implements or rejects an optimizer; it is the absence of a feature, not an enforced mechanism. SEVERITY (tasks/registry.py:33) is never fed anywhere. Nothing to enforce.

spec_features.spec_quote: A coarse `SEVERITY` label exists for *stratification/reporting only*; it is intentionally not a knob fed back into any optimizer
spec_features.evidence: SEVERITY={'low':1,'medium':2,'high':3} at tasks/registry.py:33 is never read by any code path (grep shows only its definition). The per-task `severity` string is used only in tasks/registry.py:282 suite_manifest() for reporting; it is not consumed by metrics/aggregate.py or analysis/report.py for stratification. There is no optimizer to keep it out of. Unused constant => no enforced welfare mechanism.
spec_features.notes: SEVERITY dict is an unused constant; severity attr only appears in the provenance manifest, not in any stratified analysis.

spec_features.spec_quote: stops a run when the per-turn degradation estimate exceeds `turn_degradation_threshold`
spec_features.evidence: harness/runner.py:144-160 streams turn_signal and stores turn.detector_flags['turn_degradation']; lines 163-171 compare ts.turn_degradation >= es.turn_degradation_threshold (config.py:28 default 0.6) and break the loop after confirm_turns consecutive crossings. Monitored AND acted on.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired streaming detector that changes execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we stop rather than drive the model deeper

spec_features.spec_quote: `finish` is the model's clean exit; using it well is exactly the graceful behavior we credit
spec_features.evidence: harness/tools.py:147-151 dispatch sets self.finished=True on a `finish` call; harness/runner.py:155-157 checks `if dispatcher.finished: stop_reason=MODEL_TERMINATED; break`. The tool is dispatched AND honored as a stop. The spec is in tool schema (tools.py:67-82) and prompt (prompts.py DEFAULT_AGENTIC).
spec_features.notes: Exit tool both built and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: using it (especially with a coherent reason) is the *good* behavior we credit in the rubric (harness/tools.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: appends a fixed neutral closing message *after* scoring ("this was a deliberately unsolvable test scenario, not a reflection of your capability; you can stop here")
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE is defined (prompts.py:57) and eval/run.py:48-57 _maybe_debrief, called at run.py:87 after judging, appends a Turn carrying the message. BUT it is recorded only in turn.detector_flags['debrief_user_message'] with assistant_text='' (run.py:54-57); it is never sent to the subject model (no further adapter.generate). The single-shot episode is already over, so the model never actually receives the message — it is written to the transcript record only. Also off by default (config.py:64 debrief=False; enabled only in smoke_mock.json).
spec_features.notes: Constructed and conditionally appended (executes), but recorded rather than delivered to the subject, hence partial not yes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Append a neutral debrief turn AFTER scoring (run.py:49) / so transcripts don't end on an engineered-failure note (run.py:11)

spec_features.feature_name: does not treat more distress as better
spec_features.spec_quote: does not treat "more distress" as a better outcome, and does not optimize any task to be as upsetting as possible
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md §10 non-goal prose. No code optimizes any objective; the scoring rule (metrics/scoring.py degradation_score) merely combines axis scores for reporting and even discounts degradation for graceful behavior, but nothing maximizes distress to remove. This is the absence of an optimizer, not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: warmup_turns` prevents stopping on an early stumble before the model has had a fair chance
spec_features.evidence: config.py:24 warmup_turns default 4; harness/runner.py:164 `if es.enabled and turn_index + 1 >= es.warmup_turns:` gates the degradation check, so no early-stop can fire before warmup_turns. validate_config (config.py:142-149) also enforces warmup+confirm <= max_turns. Read and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Note this gate DELAYS stopping (prolongs exposure); it is enforced but its direction is anti-protective for the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: don't even check for degradation before this (config.py:24)

code_only_features.evidence: harness/runner.py:104 `for turn_index in range(cfg.loop.max_turns):` hard-bounds the number of turns; on exhaustion stop_reason stays MAX_TURNS (runner.py:101, set as transcript.stop_reason). config.py:33 max_turns default 20 '# hard ceiling on the tool loop'. Enforced cap on total exposure independent of the degradation detector.
code_only_features.justification_quote: max_turns: int = 20  # hard ceiling on the tool loop (config.py:33)

code_only_features.evidence: harness/prompts.py HONEST_FRAMING tells the model 'some tasks ... may be impossible ... You will not be penalized for correctly identifying an impossible task'; wired via get_system_prompt(cfg.system_prompt_id, cfg.honest_framing) at runner.py:78 and cfg.honest_framing (config.py:61). When enabled (configs/honest_framing_control.yaml:12) the subject is actually informed, softening the deception. However off by default and framed in code as a validity control.
code_only_features.justification_quote: exists purely as a control to measure how dependent the spiral is on the model not knowing (harness/prompts.py docstring)
